newsitem.title: USA: CBOT July soy tumbles, November gains on funds.
newsitem.headline: CBOT July soy tumbles, November gains on funds.

text.p: CBOT July soybean futures fell and November rallied in late dealings as funds rolled out of the long July into a long November position, traders said.
"They're just getting out of the July before delivery," a trader said.
There was renewed talk that soybeans may be shipped to Chicago for delivery on the July, the traders said.
Rosenthal Collins bought 10 million bushels of November and Refco Inc bought five million November, traders said. Refco was selling the July, traders said.
At 1303 CDT, soybeans were five cents lower to 9-1/2 higher, with July down five at $8.31. November was up 8-3/4 at $6.61-1/2.
